name: KHATT: Handwritten Arabic Text Database
description: KHATT (KFUPM Handwritten Arabic Text Database) is a comprehensive offline Arabic handwriting database developed jointly by King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM), Technical University of Dortmund, and Braunschweig University of Technology, and distributed via the Linguistic Data Consortium (LDC2015T23). Collected from 1,000 distinct male and female writers spanning various age groups and educational backgrounds, KHATT consists of 4,000 document page forms (4 forms per writer: fixed text, paragraph free writing, and metadata forms) scanned at 200, 300, and 600 DPI, yielding over 9,300 segmented handwritten text lines. The collection provides verified ground-truth Unicode text and is stratified into standard train (70%), validation (15%), and test (15%) splits.
